commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

90+4' What a chance that is! Mario Gila (Lazio) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
90+2' Substitution. Jesus Rodriguez walks off the pitch and Nicolas-Gerrit Kuhn (Como) comes on as a substitute.
90+2' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Lazio hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
87' Fouls committed – 13:11.
83' A corner kick by Como is thwarted by the well prepared Ivan Provedel (Lazio).

83' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Ivan Provedel is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Como will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
82' Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
79' A substitution has been made. Nico Paz is replaced by Sergi Roberto (Como).
78' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Maxence Caqueret (Como) replaces Maximo Perrone.
77' Crossbar! Mergim Vojvoda (Como) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range crashed against the crossbar.
75' The referee signals a substitution. Boulaye Dia (Lazio) is brought on as a substitute for Fisayo Dele-Bashiru.
75' A yellow card is awarded to Taty Castellanos (Lazio).
75' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) is given a fully deserved yellow card.

73' 2 - 0 Nico Paz (Como) takes a fantastic free kick and the ball ends up in the back of the net! He unleashes a shot from 20 metres out which goes towards the top left corner, ricocheting in off the post. A truly sensational moment.

71' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Adam Marusic (Lazio). Gianluca Manganiello saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Como earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.

71' What an opportunity! Alvaro Morata (Como) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
70' Cesc Fabregas decides to make a substitution. Ignace Van der Brempt will be replaced by Ivan Smolcic (Como).
70' The game has come to an end for Anastasios Douvikas. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Alvaro Morata (Como).
68' Adam Marusic (Lazio) plays a one-two with Matteo Guendouzi, but the move breaks down. The ball is behind the touchline and Lazio will take a throw-in.
66' Here is a change. Nuno Tavares is going off and Maurizio Sarri gives the last tactical orders to Luca Pellegrini (Lazio).
66' Here's the change. Danilo Cataldi leaves the pitch and Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) comes on as a substitute.
65' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Lazio due to an offside in the build-up play.
64' The Lazio players halt their celebrations as referee Gianluca Manganiello makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
63' Goal! Taty Castellanos (Lazio) displays his shooting ability and the ball sails inside the back of the net!

62' Anastasios Douvikas sprays a pass out to Jacobo Ramon (Como), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
61' Maurizio Sarri prepares a substitution. Manuel Lazzari is replaced by Adam Marusic (Lazio).
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pedro (Lazio) will replace Matteo Cancellieri.
59' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 11:3.

59' That's unlucky! Mergim Vojvoda (Como) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
58' A pass by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
57' The Como players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
56' The game is interrupted. Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
55' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
54' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle. Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) commits a foul after dangerous play.
54' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle and it's Fisayo Dele-Bashiru (Lazio) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
52' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
50' Como failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
50' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Lucas Da Cunha (Como). Como force a corner. They send men into the box.
47' 1 - 0 Anastasios Douvikas (Como) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Ivan Provedel with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:0.
46' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but he misses the left post by a whisker. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
44' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) forces a pass into the box, but Ivan Provedel is alert and does a great job to rob him of the ball.
43' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
42' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) is penalised for holding. Gianluca Manganiello signals a set piece. Como are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
40' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
38' The referee is firm and issues Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) a deserved yellow card.

37' Nico Paz (Como) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
36' The ball is cleared after Nuno Tavares (Lazio) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Como will have a goal kick.

35' This was a piece of cake for Jean Butez. Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
35' The cross into the penalty area from Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
34' Dangerous play by Ignace Van der Brempt (Como). Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
32' The possession of the ball – 73:27.
31' Marc Oliver Kempf swings in the free kick towards Lucas Da Cunha (Como), who powers a header high over the bar from close in. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
30' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) can count himself lucky for not being sent off after only receiving a caution from the referee.
26' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

25' Alex Valle (Como) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Como have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

24' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the right post is blocked by Ivan Provedel, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
23' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
23' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) sends a sweet pass into the box towards Mergim Vojvoda. He looks to dribble past an opposing player, but fails and the ball is cleared. Como get a corner.

21' Great ball in from Mergim Vojvoda. Jesus Rodriguez (Como) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
19' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
17' Nico Paz (Como) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
16' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle after Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.

16' Jacobo Ramon (Como) shows off his individual ability with a jinking run into the box. Unfortunately, the finish lets him down as the ball flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
14' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Lazio.
13' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
11' Nico Paz (Como) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Alex Valle (Como) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Gianluca Manganiello who sees an offensive foul.
10' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
8' Como are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
5' That's a well-taken pass by Nico Paz (Como). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
5' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) will take the corner.

5' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The linesman makes the right call and Como will have a corner.
3' Alex Valle (Como) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Como move the ball around well as they wait for an opportunity to shoot, but the attack is halted as they lose possession.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Como will take the kick-off.
Gianluca Manganiello will referee today's match.
